changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.FIELD_ATTRIBUTIONS ( ATTRIBUTION_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, RESULT_ID NUMBER(19) NOT NULL, FIELD_NAME VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, STRUCTURER_NAME VARCHAR2(40 CHAR) NOT NULL, STRUCTURER_VERSION VARCHAR2(80 CHAR) NOT NULL, RAW_CONFIDENCE NUMBER(10,6), CALIBRATED_CONFIDENCE NUMBER(3,2) NOT NULL, WAS_SELECTED CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, FIELD_VALUE VARCHAR2(512 CHAR), LATENCY_MS NUMBER(8), COUNTRY_HINT CHAR(2), CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_ATTR PRIMARY KEY (ATTRIBUTION_ID, CREATED_AT), CONSTRAINT FK_ATTR_RESULT FOREIGN KEY (RESULT_ID) REFERENCES TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.STRUCTURING_RESULTS(RESULT_ID), CONSTRAINT CK_ATTR_FIELD CHECK (FIELD_NAME IN ('CTRY','TWN_NM','PST_CD','CTRY_SUB_DVSN','STRT_NM','BLDG_NB','BLDG_NM','ADR_LINE')), CONSTRAINT CK_ATTR_SELECTED CHECK (WAS_SELECTED IN ('Y','N')), CONSTRAINT CK_ATTR_CONF CHECK (CALIBRATED_CONFIDENCE BETWEEN 0 AND 1) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (CREATED_AT) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(7, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));
